description: Which Taiwan companies one type of institutional investor bought or sold most over the last 1, 5 or 20 trading days ending on date (default the latest). category: foreign = foreign and mainland Chinese investors (excluding foreign-owned dealers); trust = securities investment trusts (domestic funds); dealer = securities dealers (proprietary trading plus hedging). side=buy lists the largest net buying, sell the largest net selling; companies only (no ETFs). Each row has net_shares (the period total), estimated_value (each day's net shares times that day's close, added up), the last day's close and change, and period_change_pct (the last close against the close on base_date, the trading day before the period); estimated_value, period_change_pct and multi-day totals are calculated by Livermore. date must be one of the latest 30 trading days with institutional data (recent_dates); other dates return an error listing them. Use tw_get_daily_trading for one stock's daily history. Taiwan conventions: money is in New Taiwan dollars (currency TWD), share counts are in shares (1 lot = 1,000 shares), prices are in TWD and fields ending in _pct are percentages (12.5 means 12.5%). market is TWSE (listed) or TPEx (OTC). Names are in Traditional Chinese, with name_en where available. url links to tw.livermore.club, whose pages are in Traditional Chinese only. Keep `attribution` when you present the data: Taiwan's Open Government Data License requires naming its sources, and fields listed in computed_by_livermore are Livermore's calculations, not official figures.

category.description: Investor type: foreign = foreign and mainland Chinese investors (excluding foreign-owned dealers); trust = securities investment trusts (domestic funds); dealer = securities dealers (proprietary trading plus hedging). Default foreign.

date.description: The last day of the period, YYYY-MM-DD: one of the latest 30 trading days with institutional data (recent_dates). Default the latest.

days.description: Period length in trading days: 1 (default), 5 or 20, ending on `date`.

side.description: buy: largest net buying (default); sell: largest net selling.

name: tw_list_institutional_ranking

attribution.description: Required attribution: Taiwan's Open Government Data License requires naming the sources when you present or pass on this data, and Livermore's own calculations must be kept apart from the official figures.

computed_by_livermore.description: Fields calculated by Livermore from the official data (not published by the sources). Present them as Livermore's calculations, apart from the official figures.

license.description: The license of the data from `sources`; null when no such data was used.

other_sources.description: Sources that are not government open data and not under the license (industry chains).

sources.description: The government open data providers whose data this result uses.

base_date.description: The trading day before the period; period_change_pct compares with its close.

currency.description: Every amount of money in this result is in New Taiwan dollars (TWD).

recent_dates.description: The latest 30 trading days with institutional data (valid dates).

change.description: Change on the last day, as published.

close.description: Close on the last day of the period.

estimated_value.description: Each day's net shares times that day's close, added up (TWD), calculated by Livermore.

market.description: TWSE = listed on the Taiwan Stock Exchange; TPEx = traded on the Taipei Exchange (OTC market).

net_shares.description: Net shares bought (negative: sold) over the period.

period_change_pct.description: Last close divided by the close on base_date, minus 1 (%), calculated by Livermore.

title: Taiwan institutional net buying ranking
